summary: Hickenlooper cosponsored the 2025 Antisemitism Awareness Act, which directs use of the IHRA definition for campus investigations, and voted with the Republican majority to defeat two resolutions that would have partially blocked military aid to Israel. His October 2025 ceasefire remarks paired humanitarian aid for Palestinians with security for Israelis, and his June 2025 post framed a memorial around antisemitism rather than Gaza. He co-signed a letter urging action on West Bank settler violence. Vote for Peace lists him as opposed.
